phase_note: Phase 1 is report-only. No loop may write to the repository, push, merge, deploy, comment, or call a provider. Enabling an action-capable loop requires a separate, explicitly approved task.

global_kill_switch.semantics: If this file exists, every loop must halt. Absence of the file is not permission to act; it only means the global halt is not engaged.

global_forbidden_paths_note: Every loop entry must repeat this baseline in its own forbidden_paths list. The validator enforces the superset rule so that drift becomes a validation failure rather than a silent gap.

levels.L0: Manual. A human runs it; the loop definition only documents intent.
levels.L1: Report-only. Reads state and emits findings. No repository mutation.
levels.L2: Assisted. May propose a change behind a human gate. Not permitted in Phase 1.
levels.L3: Unattended. Not designed, not configured, and not permitted in Phase 1.

loops.title: Project Health Report
loops.purpose: Report repository state, validator outcomes, active blockers, and the current task position so an operator can see project status without reading every shared_context file.
loops.success_condition: A health report is produced that names the current branch, the validator outcome, and any open blocker, with every claim traceable to a file that was actually read.
loops.escalation_condition: The validator cannot be run, the repository state contradicts shared_context, or the loop cannot substantiate a claim it is about to make.

loops.title: Shared Context Drift Report
loops.purpose: Report contradictions between shared_context files, the roadmap, the run queue, the safety documents, and PROJECT_RULES.md, so that stale or conflicting claims are surfaced rather than inherited.
loops.success_condition: Each reported contradiction cites both sides with file path and quoted claim, and is proposed for CONTRADICTION_LEDGER.md rather than written to it.
loops.escalation_condition: A contradiction touches a safety rule, or the loop cannot determine which side is authoritative.

loops.title: Safety Posture Report
loops.purpose: Report on forbidden capabilities, secret-shaped strings, environment files, provider configuration, and the MellyCore/MellyTrade separation boundary.
loops.success_condition: A posture report is produced that names category and location for every finding and never reproduces a candidate secret value.
loops.escalation_condition: Any suspected real credential, any .env file in the working tree, or any MellyTrade execution surface appearing inside MellyCore.

loops.title: PR And Review Readiness Report
loops.purpose: Report the readiness of open work for review: what is committed, what is validated, and what is still missing. Reporting only.
loops.success_condition: A readiness summary is produced locally. No comment is posted, no branch is pushed, no PR is opened, edited, approved, or merged.
loops.escalation_condition: Any request or apparent need to comment, push, approve, or merge. This loop has no such capability and must escalate instead.

loops.title: Worktree Hygiene Report
loops.purpose: Report linked worktrees, branch ownership, dirty worktrees, staleness, and collision risk between concurrent agent tasks.
loops.success_condition: Worktrees are listed with branch, HEAD, and risk notes, using read-only git inspection only.
loops.escalation_condition: Two worktrees appear to own the same task or branch, or a worktree looks abandoned. The operator decides; the loop never removes anything.

loops.title: Changelog Draft Report
loops.purpose: Produce a local changelog draft from committed history for operator review. Drafting only.
loops.allowed_write_scope_note: Empty by design. The draft is returned in the run report for the operator to place. The loop does not write repository files in Phase 1.
loops.success_condition: A draft is produced that describes only work actually present in committed history. No release is tagged, published, or announced.
loops.escalation_condition: History is ambiguous, or the draft would need to claim an outcome not evidenced by a commit.

loops.title: CI Failure Sweeper
loops.purpose: Future direction only. Would triage failing checks. Defined so the boundary is explicit and reviewable; no automatic fix attempts are authorized in Phase 1.
allowed_write_scope: FUTURE_ONLY: scoped source paths, to be defined and approved in a separate task
loops.success_condition: Not applicable in Phase 1. This loop is disabled.
loops.escalation_condition: Any invocation while disabled must stop and report.
loops.disabled_reason: Automatic fix attempts are out of scope for Phase 1. Enabling requires a separate approved task, an independent verifier, and demonstrated report-only history.

loops.title: Dependency Sweeper
loops.purpose: Future direction only. Would report and eventually propose dependency updates. No dependency changes are authorized in Phase 1.
allowed_write_scope: FUTURE_ONLY: dependency manifests, to be defined and approved in a separate task
loops.success_condition: Not applicable in Phase 1. This loop is disabled.
loops.escalation_condition: Any invocation while disabled must stop and report.
loops.disabled_reason: MellyCore currently has no runtime dependency manifest, and dependency changes are out of scope for Phase 1.

loops.title: Post-Merge Cleanup
loops.purpose: Future direction only. Would report merged branches and stale worktrees as cleanup candidates. Report-only candidate pending separate approval.
allowed_write_scope: FUTURE_ONLY: none proposed; cleanup would remain an operator action
loops.success_condition: Not applicable in Phase 1. This loop is disabled.
loops.escalation_condition: Any invocation while disabled must stop and report.
loops.disabled_reason: Branch and worktree deletion are destructive git actions requiring explicit operator approval. Even a report-only version needs separate sign-off.
